ui_bugs.issue: Prices still render as $5.00/mo and $39.99/yr (RevenueCat test offering) instead of required $9.00 / $90.00 — regression from iteration_38 NOT fixed. Screenshot: /tmp/iter39_paywall.png. Fallback constants in code are $9.00/$90.00 (paywall.tsx:80,86) but RC test-store returns a non-null pkg so fallback never fires. Fix: update RevenueCat offering in dashboard OR force override display prices in paywall.tsx (dev/test builds only).

The board selector is a modal-driven dropdown behind the '💪 STRENGTH · LEVEL ▾' label. Tapping the label via Playwright (force click on text) did not surface the picker overlay in the web preview — likely a Modal transform + touch-target issue on web. Not a code correctness bug (BOARDS array includes {key:'defender', label:'🛡 DEFENDERS'} at line 43), but reduces automation testability. Consider adding testID='board-picker' on the label Pressable and testID='board-defender' on each option row.

rca_of_issue: Paywall $9/$90 mismatch RCA (unchanged from iter38): /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:80 reads `monthlyPkg?.product.priceString || "$9.00"`. RevenueCat test-store returns a real package with priceString='$5.00' so the fallback never fires. Fix by (a) updating the RevenueCat offering in the dashboard to $9/$90 for BOTH test store and prod, or (b) hard-override displayed priceString when running against EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_TEST_API_KEY.
